text:
Please contact your vet or your local poison control center right away. Pothos is not pet-safe, so don't wait for symptoms to appear. Have the plant name and roughly how much your dog chewed ready when you call.

I'm also escalating this to a Support Lead as our policy requires for safety issues. Our chat is open 8am–8pm Mon–Sat, and you can email help@leafy.example (answered within 1 business day), but please call the vet or poison control first, since we don't offer phone support.
